notes:
Everything since 0.7, in one beta:

- Call it from your phone: tap Call in your Telegram chat and talk to Hotaru from anywhere.
- It calls you: "do this, then call me" - your phone rings with an Answer button when it's done.
- It texts you first: "text me when it's done", and reminders reach your phone when you're away from the PC.
- Find my files: "find the PDF I downloaded yesterday" - open it, show it, or send it to your phone.
- Tell me when: "tell me when my download finishes", "text me when Blender closes", "let me know when the battery's full".
- Morning brief: weather, what's on today, your to-dos, plus calendar and email if connected (Settings -> Routines).
- Souls: six new looks in Settings -> Soul - Hotaru, Ember, Wisp, Amethyst, Gilded and Void.
- Personalities: Warm, Chill, Hype, Calm, Witty, Sassy, Focused, or write your own.
- Report a problem: Settings -> General, or just say "report a problem".
